coordinate_space: Sprite2656/BattleScene battlefield world coordinates, using the soldier foot anchor
why_no_conversion: Formation Sprite2656 and battle Sprite2456 use the same root transform and world coordinate convention.
screen_entry: clone committed state into a working state; if absent, derive from current BattleScene initial positions and snap/collision-resolve once
confirm: validate 30 unique legal cells, then atomically replace committed state
cancel: discard working edits and restore the screen-entry snapshot; outgoing navigation remains unconnected
battle_scene: before creating player Soldier views/entities, resolve by soldierId then rosterIndex and use worldX/worldY as the initial foot-anchor position
roster_changes: keep matching soldierIds, fill new/missing members into the nearest free legal cell deterministically
storage: use the existing game-session/store object. Do not add localStorage unless the project already persists the same player data there.
swf_reference: sv serializes each of 30 x/36 and y/36 values into fmdat; jksv additionally supports SharedObject slots, which are outside this scope.
